title_en: AdaFloor: Adaptive Floor Planning and Rank-Time Reuse for Long-Tail MoE RL Rollouts
title_zh: AdaFloor：面向长尾MoE RL Rollout的自适应Floor规划与Rank时间复用
summary_en: AdaFloor targets response-length imbalance in synchronous MoE reinforcement-learning post-training, where completed ranks remain blocked on Expert Parallelism (EP) collectives and expert ownership. In a representative 16-accelerator Qwen3-30B-A3B rollout, dummy runs trap 32.83% of rank-time. AdaFloor converts this EP-coupled capacity into bounded leases for auxiliary work, using historical prompt-tail prediction and a calibrated guard to build a KV-safe layout, then selecting the floor-specific safe quorum schedule with the largest predicted release area; at runtime it shrinks the EP group and leases detached ranks until full-world restoration. On DeepScaleR math rollouts across three updated-policy seeds, the capacity-oriented Natural floor2 configuration with TailGuard cuts Vanilla's 29393.9 dummy rank-seconds by 96.15%, leaving 1131.7 rank-seconds. For sidecar reuse, Planned residency floor4 without TailGuard serves 3134 Qwen3-8B GSM8K queries per epoch at 99.46% accuracy with only 2-3% primary throughput loss, while the latency-oriented Planned residency floor4 with TailGuard reduces rollout time by 24.09%.
summary_zh: AdaFloor 针对同步 MoE 强化学习后训练中的响应长度不均衡问题：已完成的 rank 仍被 Expert Parallelism（EP）集合通信与专家归属绑定。在具有代表性的 16 加速器 Qwen3-30B-A3B rollout 中，空转运行占用了 32.83% 的 rank 时间。AdaFloor 将这部分与 EP 耦合的容量转化为有界租约以执行辅助工作：利用历史 prompt 尾部预测与校准守卫构建 KV 安全布局，再选择预测释放面积最大的 floor 专属安全 quorum 调度；运行时收缩 EP 组并租出脱离的 rank，直至全量恢复。在 DeepScaleR 数学推理 rollout 的三个更新策略种子上，面向容量的 Natural floor2 + TailGuard 配置将 Vanilla 的 29393.9 rank-秒空转减少 96.15%，剩余 1131.7 rank-秒。在 sidecar 复用方面，Planned residency floor4（无 TailGuard）每 epoch 以 99.46% 准确率服务 3134 条 Qwen3-8B GSM8K 查询，主任务吞吐仅下降 2-3%；面向延迟的 Planned residency floor4 + TailGuard 将 rollout 时间减少 24.09%。
content_en: Synchronous MoE reinforcement-learning post-training suffers from response-length imbalance. Existing methods reduce request tails, yet completed ranks remain bound to Expert Parallelism (EP) collectives and expert ownership. In a representative 16-accelerator Qwen3-30B-A3B rollout, this dummy run traps 32.83% of rank-time. AdaFloor converts this EP-coupled capacity into bounded leases for auxiliary work to improve system resource efficiency through rank-time reuse. Historical prompt-tail prediction and a calibrated guard construct the KV-safe layout. AdaFloor then selects the floor-specific safe quorum schedule with the largest predicted release area. Its runtime shrinks the EP group and leases detached ranks until full-world restoration. Across three updated-policy seeds on DeepScaleR mathematical reasoning rollouts, its capacity-oriented Natural floor2 configuration with TailGuard reduces Vanilla's 29393.9 rank-seconds of dummy run by 96.15%. Rollout shortening eliminates 18693.6 rank-seconds, while coordinated exits convert another 9568.6 rank-seconds into reusable capacity, leaving 1131.7 rank-seconds. For sidecar reuse, its Planned residency floor4 configuration without TailGuard serves 3134 Qwen3-8B GSM8K queries per epoch at 99.46% accuracy and incurs only a 2 to 3% primary throughput reduction against the same configuration with sidecar execution disabled.
